name: Survive Area 51
summary: Dive into the enigmatic world of Area 51 with this immersive Gorilla Tag fan experience. Explore a labyrinth of hidden chambers and high-security zones, each filled with mysteries and potential threats. Utilize your agility and wits to navigate the facility, uncovering secrets that have been buried deep within. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, prepare for a heart-pounding adventure that challenges your courage and curiosity.
